name: prd-to-prod-hooks
//: Scopes this directory tree back to CommonJS. The hooks and their utils/ and validators/ trees are written with require(), but the repository root sets "type": "module" because the application is ESM (Node --experimental-strip-types, Vite, ESM imports throughout). Node resolves the module system from the NEAREST package.json walking upward, so this one file restores CommonJS semantics for everything under hooks/ without renaming a file or altering a line of guard logic.
